profile: PostgreSQL 16.6 and 17.2 under the registered native Boolean and int4 predicate profiles.
scope: The six IS [NOT] TRUE, FALSE and UNKNOWN forms over checked Boolean predicates.

Predicate/TruthOperator.role: One of the six Boolean truth tests.
Predicate/TruthOperator.structure: Exact selection of the TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN value with or without negation.
Predicate/TruthOperator.conditions: The enum has exactly the six registered values. It is used with a checked Boolean operand.
Predicate/TruthOperator.meaning: Compare the operand's three-valued truth result to the chosen truth value. Complement the result for a negated form.
Predicate/TruthOperator.externalInterpretation: The built-in PostgreSQL Boolean domain and normal NULL semantics.
Predicate/TruthOperator.sql: Emit the exact built-in IS [NOT] phrase.

Predicate/TruthTest.role: A Boolean result from testing one checked Boolean operand.
Predicate/TruthTest.structure: One truth operator and one operand from the closed Boolean and NULL roles. A nested truth test has the same Boolean result role.
Predicate/TruthTest.conditions: The enclosing scope checks all visible references and bounds all operand occurrences. The analyzer admits plain NULL, explicitly Boolean NULL and checked predicates.
Predicate/TruthTest.meaning: Test the operand exactly once. Every form yields true or false, including when the operand is NULL. A WHERE clause admits true rows.
Predicate/TruthTest.externalInterpretation: Interpret the operand using its fixed source slots and built-in Boolean and integer rules.
Predicate/TruthTest.sql: Parenthesize the child test with the checked IS phrase. A NULL leaf is a Boolean NULL in this position.
